**Why it matters:** If it starts tonight as it is, the run has nothing that lets it reach the gate. The repository token has already expired, and P1 and P2 would both log in with the same write test account at the same time, so the run would likely stall or produce clashing test data with nobody watching. Set the window to 2026-11-20 22:00 → 2026-11-21 08:00, and decide whether those times are local or UTC (the current record uses `Z`). Add `covers` to every entry. Replace `REPO_TOKEN` with one that expires after the window ends. Give P2 its own clerk account (E4 already probes `clerk-b`, but no account entry lists it).
3. Run `python .claude/skills/alchemy-orchestrate/scripts/check_orchestration.py preflight .alchemy/runs/r1/preflight.json --plan .alchemy/runs/r1/plan.json --profile alchemy-workspace.json --root .` and start only on `PASS`.
